name: The Lady Most Wicked: Side Story 01
source:
Victoria Revelle is your standard reincarnated villainess who must navigate between the lines of mystery, romance, and murder. But, just for today, she's resolved not to worry about all that.

[From [url=https://fableknot.itch.io/lady-most-wicked01]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维多利亚·雷维尔是一名标准的转生恶役千金，平日里不得不在悬疑、恋爱与谋杀的夹缝间小心周旋。不过，单单只有今天，她下定决心要把那些烦心事统统抛在脑后。

[摘自[url=https://fableknot.itch.io/lady-most-wicked01]itch.io[/url]]
